entities.name: Wanderwine River
entities.description: Greatest river in Lorwyn, sourced at Mount Tanufel and heavily trafficked by merrow.

entities.name: Mount Tanufel
entities.description: Site of the spring from which the river flows.

entities.name: The Source
entities.description: Elemental guarding the spring of the Wanderwine.

entities.name: Merrow
entities.description: Lorwyn people whose crannogs line the river.

entities.name: Captain Sygg
entities.description: Ferryman and riverguide on the Wanderwine in 4520 AR.

entities.name: Ashling
entities.description: Flamekin ferried across the river by Sygg.

entities.name: Vendilion clique
entities.description: Faeries ferried across by Sygg, who rescued the passengers.

entities.name: Kinsbaile
entities.description: Kithkin clachan the crossing led to.

events.summary: In 4520 AR Captain Sygg ferried Ashling, a kithkin family and the Vendilion clique across the river.
events.quote: he brought the flamekin Ashling , a kithkin family, and the Vendilion clique across the river

events.summary: An arbomander attacked and knocked Sygg unconscious; the faeries reluctantly rescued the passengers.
events.quote: the faeries reluctantly rescued the passengers from the river

relations.quote: he was attacked by an arbomander and knocked unconscious
